findings.title: Missing XML sitemap declared in robots.txt or available at /sitemap.xml
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.iana.org/sitemap.xml via http_get_sitemap_check [2026-08-29T17:49:58Z]: Request to https://www.iana.org/sitemap.xml did not return a valid sitemap and no 'Sitemap:' directive was found in robots.txt. (Confidence: high)

suggested_action.summary: Publish an XML sitemap and declare its location in robots.txt.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Generate an XML sitemap for public indexable URLs and add 'Sitemap: https://yourdomain.com/sitemap.xml' to robots.txt.

evidence_details.observation: Request to https://www.iana.org/sitemap.xml did not return a valid sitemap and no 'Sitemap:' directive was found in robots.txt.

findings.title: Missing Schema.org Organization structured data on root landing page
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.iana.org/ via jsonld_schema_extractor [2026-08-29T17:49:58Z]: Root homepage contains 0 Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema blocks. (Confidence: high)

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD markup to the homepage.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a JSON-LD script on the homepage declaring @type 'Organization' with name, url, logo, and sameAs links to authoritative profiles.

evidence_details.observation: Root homepage contains 0 Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema blocks.

findings.title: Missing meta description on key landing page
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.iana.org/ via html_meta_inspector [2026-08-29T17:49:58Z]: Page HTML contains no <meta name="description"> tag, depriving search and AI engines of an authoritative snippet summary. (Confidence: high)

suggested_action.summary: Add an informative meta description tag.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add <meta name="description" content="..."> summarizing the brand and page offerings.

evidence_details.observation: Page HTML contains no <meta name="description"> tag, depriving search and AI engines of an authoritative snippet summary.

findings.title: Deep hierarchical page lacks breadcrumb navigation trail

proactive_recommendations.title: Publish an llms.txt file to guide AI assistants to authoritative documentation
proactive_recommendations.rationale: Emerging AI web standards like /llms.txt provide large language models with a curated, markdown-formatted directory of core brand documentation and APIs.

suggested_action.summary: Create an llms.txt file in the root web directory.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add an /llms.txt file containing markdown links to your primary product, documentation, pricing, and company overview pages.
